## Verdict: PASS

All six rows are fixed and pinned; every pin was re-killed by the seat's own mutant. All gates are green;
`landed:verify` passes for the item and its notes record; no export of the folder index was added, removed or renamed;
the refusal census did not rise (every class 0 after, re-measured on the full bar sizes); the re-recorded summary is
reproduced **byte for byte** by the seat's own bar run at another worker count. 44 targeted mutants: **38 killed**,
6 survivors — X2h, X2k, X2p **equivalent in practice** (receipts P2 and two 500-face signature reruns), X2m, K10f and
X3g test-tightness gaps on code the seat confirmed correct or unreached. No blocker; five new notes (N-9 – N-13).
